evidence: app/src/pages/abilities/[name].astro:1 — the entire Abilities feature is one route file
app/src/pages/pokemon/[name].astro:170-176 — the only other Abilities code is one self-contained Section in the Pokémon page
app/src/layouts/Layout.astro:23-27 — nav contains only Pokémon and Types, so no link cleanup is needed
app/src/lib/pokedex.ts:123-141 — cardsForPokemon is shared with moves/types pages, so removing Abilities leaves no dead helpers
removability.rationale: Deleting the abilities route plus one Section block removes the feature completely; nothing else links to it and no ability-only code exists in shared modules.

evidence: app/src/components/PokemonCard.astro:13 — every card sprite is computed in exactly one render point via spriteUrl(card.id)
app/src/lib/api.ts:75 — spriteUrl is the single sprite-URL rule

app/src/lib/pokedex.ts:137 — cardsForPokemon sorts/derives cards for move, ability and type pages, but the home list is built separately at app/src/pages/index.astro:66 from SpeciesEntry, so a Card-model change touches two construction paths
app/src/pages/index.astro:105-111 and app/src/pages/pokemon/[name].astro:229-234 — the fetch→DOMParser→replaceWith client-swap pattern is duplicated verbatim
changeability.rationale: Render-level fixes are one-place and obvious, but the Card data model is constructed in two paths and the client-side swap logic is copy-pasted, so data-level fixes land in 2–3 findable places rather than one.

evidence: app/src/lib/api.ts:8-88 — one narrow data client (api, resourcePath, listPath, idFromUrl, spriteUrl, mapAll); base URL and cache constants live only here
app/src/components/CardGrid.astro:1-14 — components take explicit Props and know nothing about pages
app/src/pages/index.astro:78-131 — server work is frontmatter, client enhancement is a separate <script> with a <noscript> fallback at line 49
app/src/lib/api.ts:10,21 — api() returns Promise<any> and every page casts inline (e.g. app/src/pages/pokemon/[name].astro:36-41,50), so consumers depend on untyped record internals
app/src/pages/types/[name].astro:26 and app/src/pages/index.astro:26 — pages rebuild their own type-label Map instead of the existing helper app/src/lib/pokedex.ts:53
coupling.rationale: Clean seams between pages, components and the data client, with clear server/client separation; the main tangle is the pervasive `any` at the API boundary, which makes refactor-safety depend on grep rather than the compiler.

evidence: app/src/lib/pokedex.ts:117-141 — the Card model plus cardsForPokemon's optional `extra` callback handles per-source variation (hidden flags, alternate forms, dedup) without flag parameters
app/src/lib/pokedex.ts:44-115 — getSpeciesIndex centralizes the cross-referencing of species/types/generations once for all pages
app/src/components/Section.astro:1-14 and TypeBadge.astro:1-18 — small, focused primitives reused across all pages
app/src/components/MovesTable.astro:15,21-28 — showLevel is a mild boolean flag, though it reflects a real column difference
app/src/pages/moves/[name].astro:39-64 — the facts <dl> block would need copying for an Items page; there is no reusable 'key-value facts' component
abstraction_design.rationale: Abstractions are designed around the app's real variation (card sources, localized labels, learn methods) and stretch well; only the moves page's facts list and a couple of small components would be copied for a similar new resource.

findings.issue: The API client is untyped (Promise<any>), so every consumer reaches into raw record internals with inline casts (app/src/pages/pokemon/[name].astro:36-41,50,104,172; app/src/lib/pokedex.ts:40,155) — renames and shape changes are invisible to the compiler.
findings.suggestion: Define per-resource interfaces (Species, Pokemon, Move, Ability, Type) in lib/pokedex.ts and have api() accept them, e.g. api<Species>(resourcePath('pokemon-species', name)).

findings.issue: Card construction is split: reference-based lists build cards via cardsForPokemon, while the home list derives them from SpeciesEntry (app/src/lib/pokedex.ts:95, app/src/pages/index.astro:66). Adding a Card field (e.g. a real sprite URL or sort key) requires touching both paths.
findings.suggestion: Add a single toCard(species: SpeciesEntry, extra?: Partial<Card>) builder used by both cardsForPokemon and the home page.

findings.issue: The fetch→DOMParser→replaceWith progressive-enhancement pattern is duplicated verbatim in the Pokémon page's game selector (app/src/pages/pokemon/[name].astro:229-234); a change to error handling or stale-response guarding must be made twice.
findings.suggestion: Extract a shared swapRegion(url, selector) helper into app/src/scripts/ next to sortable.ts, which already shows the right pattern.

findings.issue: Pages rebuild the type-label Map by hand (also app/src/pages/types/[name].astro:26) instead of the existing typeLabels() helper (app/src/lib/pokedex.ts:53), and the `?? humanize(t)` fallback is repeated in four files (PokemonCard.astro:24, pokemon/[name].astro:126, MovesTable.astro:47, moves/[name].astro:27).
findings.suggestion: Reuse typeLabels() and add a small labelFor(map, name) fallback helper so the localization rule has one home.

findings.issue: The whole Pokémon page payload is accumulated into an untyped `page: any` object, so the template at lines 92-208 is unchecked; renaming a field is a grep exercise.
findings.suggestion: Declare a PokemonPage interface for the page object so the frontmatter and template agree.

findings.issue: security.checkOrigin: false disables Astro's CSRF origin check although the app only issues GET requests (the filter form uses method="get" at app/src/pages/index.astro:22 and the client scripts only fetch GET).
findings.suggestion: Drop the checkOrigin override; the default origin check is compatible with this app's traffic.

findings.issue: showLevel is a boolean flag selecting a column; a future learn-method with different columns would grow the flag set.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable as-is given only Level Up differs; if another variant appears, pass the column list as a prop instead of a flag.

findings.issue: No test script or unit tests in the app itself; edits like the sorting change have no local safety net beyond the external acceptance suite.
findings.suggestion: Add a lightweight `test` script covering lib/pokedex.ts pure helpers (humanize, cardsForPokemon, compareMethods), which are trivially testable.

summary: A small, well-factored Astro 7 app: features map to routes, shared logic lives in two focused lib modules, and components take narrow explicit props, so removing a feature or changing the API/data layer is nearly trivial. The main editability costs are the untyped `any` API boundary, a Card model constructed in two separate paths, and a duplicated client-side swap helper. Everything is findable and low-risk to change; nothing needs rearchitecting.

scenarios.change: Remove the Abilities pages and every link to them
scenarios.notes: Delete the route file and the one Abilities Section (lines 170-176) plus its data (lines 50, 104). No nav links exist, and cardsForPokemon is still needed by moves/types, so no dead code remains.

scenarios.change: Fix the card sprite for species whose default Pokémon has a different name (e.g. Deoxys)
scenarios.notes: Rendering is single-point (PokemonCard.astro:13 via spriteUrl, api.ts:75), so a render-level fix covers every list. But if the fix needs real per-Pokémon sprite data, the Card model must grow a field, and cards are built in two places: cardsForPokemon (pokedex.ts:123-141) for move/ability/type lists and the SpeciesEntry path (index.astro:66) for the home list. `any` typing offers no compiler help.

scenarios.change: Add sorting by name to every list of Pokémon cards
scenarios.notes: Two orderings to change: cardsForPokemon's final sort (pokedex.ts:137) covers move/ability/type pages, while the home list's order comes from getSpeciesIndex's sort (pokedex.ts:95) and must be sorted before the pagination slice in index.astro:66. Doing it inside CardGrid would not work because home pagination slices first.

The move page's facts <dl> and section markup (~40 lines, moves/[name].astro:39-73) would be adapted rather than reused — there is no generic facts-list component — but no Moves code needs modification.
